title: Isomorphic Labs Secures $5 Billion in Series C Funding
excerpt: AI drug-discovery firm Isomorphic Labs has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round to advance its drug candidates toward clinical trials.
body_html:
Isomorphic Labs has secured $5 billion in a Series C funding round. The artificial intelligence drug-discovery platform plans to use the fresh capital to advance its drug candidates into clinical trials.

Originally spun out of Google's DeepMind in 2021, the company leverages AI technologies to accelerate and transform the traditional drug discovery process.
